3 years past experience supplying same/similar category products to Central/State Govt/PSU

MSE and DPIIT startup relaxation from experience and turnover (complete)

Documents: experience, past performance, turnover, OEM authorization, OEM turnover, BoQ specification compliance and ATC certificates

Scope: supply, installation, testing and commissioning of goods
Relevant categories: LED luminaire for road and street lights IS 10322 (Part 5/Sec 3); recessed LED luminaire IS 10322 (Part 5/Sec 2); XLPE cable up to 1.1 kV IS 7098 (Part 1)
